_about: Base case for Anthropic. These are judgment calls, not company guidance; keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_growth: Q3-2026 revenue was $16.96B, a $67.8B annualised run rate, +92% over LTM revenue with no further growth. Year 1 assumes ~10% sequential quarterly growth (Q2->Q3 was +47%), then a steep fade to terminal + 2%.
_margins: GAAP operating margin was +8% in Q2-2026 and -3% in Q3-2026 (after $5.0B of short-term compute and $2.0B of non-cash donation-matching charges); Adjusted Operating Margin 15-19%. Ramp to 30% GAAP (incl. SBC) at maturity.
_reinvestment: Compute is mostly bought as a service (in opex); owned capex is rising. D&A converges toward capex as the asset base matures.
_working_capital: Set on the Q3-2026 run rate rather than LTM revenue, which understates the current scale of the business.
_tax: Large tax losses shield early profits; ramps to a 23% statutory-plus-state rate.
_discount_rate: No trading history, so beta is set rather than regressed: 1.6, above high-growth software peers, for customer concentration (top 5 customers ~21% of Q3-2026 revenue), model-cycle risk (models released in the prior six months were >80% of Q3 revenue) and compute-supply risk. No debt.
